MEET THE DRAGONS

Each dragon has a unique personality and powers. Learn about them through 60+ beautiful illustrations and get involved with the world of Tricky Dragons™.

THE POWER OF ELEMENTS

In Tricky Dragons™, Fire, Water, and Grass form a delicate balance: Fire scorches Grass, Water extinguishes Fire, and Grass saps Water’s strength. Use this knowledge cleverly to gain the upper hand.

CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS

Each turn, as you draw a card, you’ll meet a new dragon and discover its unique power!

Stack your cards, outplay your friends, and be the one to play the last card. That’s how you win the round and score points!

Be the fastest to score 7 points and claim victory!

EVERY GAME A NEW ADVENTURE

100+ cards and 50+ unique effects. Tricky Dragons™ delivers ever-changing games, packed with effects that can change the course of the game in an instant!
